phase_title: Phase 15-7/15-8 測定ワークフロー実行可否判定結果の証跡固定ルール設計
phase_purpose: Phase 17-2（Phase 15-7 実行可否判定）と Phase 17-3（Phase 15-8 実行可否判定）の判定結果（PROCEED/HOLD/HALT）の完全性・改変防止を確保するための証跡固定ルール、ハッシュ、タイムスタンプ、監査ログ、改ざん検出メカニズムを設計する。判定結果を改変不可の形式で記録し、後続の Phase 15-7/15-8 測定実行時に改ざんが検出された場合は即座に処理停止できる仕組みを設計する。
execution_context: reports-only design phase; design of judgment result evidence lock mechanisms only, no actual judgment result locking or auditing yet

governance.safety_rule: All blocked_actions remain strictly prohibited. Phase 17-4 evidence lock rules are design-only; no actual judgment result locking occurs. No app/tests implementation permitted.
governance.hard_stop_condition: This phase is design-only. No actual evidence locking or tamper detection occurs.

judgment_result_evidence_lock_purpose.purpose: Design mechanisms to cryptographically lock Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 judgment results (PROCEED, HOLD, HALT decisions) and detect any tampering before Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement workflows execute, ensuring decision integrity
judgment_inputs_to_protect: All gate evaluation results (6 gates each for Phase 17-2 and 17-3)
protection_mechanisms: SHA-256+ cryptographic hashing of complete judgment reports
Append-only audit logs of judgment receipt, verification, reads, modification attempts
Tamper detection via hash recomputation and mismatch flags
judgment_result_evidence_lock_purpose.downstream_protection: Before Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement execution, hash verification confirms no tampering; if tampering detected, processing halts immediately

algorithm_1_cryptographic_hashing.algorithm_name: SHA-256 or stronger (SHA-384, SHA-512, or future approved algorithms)
algorithm_1_cryptographic_hashing.input_data: Complete Phase 17-2 judgment report JSON (or canonicalized form) + Complete Phase 17-3 judgment report JSON

hash_output_format.hash_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC timestamp of hash computation

hash_metadata.data_size_bytes: Size of combined judgment reports in bytes
hash_metadata.input_canonicalization: How JSON was canonicalized (e.g., sorted keys, no whitespace)

algorithm_1_cryptographic_hashing.security_constraint: Must NOT use MD5, SHA-1, or any algorithmically weakened hashing; only cryptographically secure algorithms

algorithm_2_digital_timestamps.primary_timestamp_semantics: Exact moment when Phase 17-2 and 17-3 judgment reports were locked
algorithm_2_digital_timestamps.optional_tsa_semantics: For future high-assurance audit scenarios; not required at initial design stage

timestamp_storage.accessible_for: Verification during Phase 15-7/15-8 entry, audit trail reconstruction

algorithm_3_audit_trail_logging.audit_trail_model: Append-only log of judgment result lifecycle events
algorithm_3_audit_trail_logging.immutability_requirement: Records must not be modified or deleted; only appended

log_entry_format.event_type: One of: JUDGMENT_LOCKED, HASH_VERIFIED_OK, HASH_VERIFIED_FAILED, TAMPER_DETECTED, VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTED, HALT_INITIATED
log_entry_format.phase_17_2_status: Current phase_17_2 result (if event affects it)
log_entry_format.phase_17_3_status: Current phase_17_3 result (if event affects it)

log_events_captured: Judgment_LOCKED: Phase 17-2/17-3 judgment locked with timestamp and hash
HASH_VERIFIED_OK: Verification successful, no tampering detected
TAMPER_DETECTED: Tampering confirmed; security alert issued
HALT_INITIATED: Processing halted due to tampering

state_1_unlocked.semantics: Phase 17-2/17-3 judgment reports exist but are not yet cryptographically locked
state_1_unlocked.transition_to_hashed: Compute hash(judgment_reports), store hash with metadata, record audit log entry

state_2_hashed.semantics: Phase 17-2/17-3 judgment reports are hashed; ready for integrity verification
state_2_hashed.transition_to_locked: Verification request → compute h2 = hash(phase_17_2_report || phase_17_3_report); if h2 == h1, transition to LOCKED and log HASH_VERIFIED_OK
state_2_hashed.transition_to_tampering_detected: If h2 != h1, record TAMPERING_DETECTED, halt, initiate forensic investigation

state_3_locked.semantics: Hash verification succeeded; judgment reports confirmed unmodified; ready for Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement entry
state_3_locked.lock_timestamp: Time when hash verification completed successfully
state_3_locked.before_phase15_7_entry: Final verification must be performed at Phase 15-7 entry; if lock status is LOCKED, proceed; otherwise halt

state_4_tampering_detected.semantics: Hash mismatch detected; judgment reports may be corrupted or intentionally altered; security investigation required
state_4_tampering_detected.tampering_response: Immediately halt processing; alert security authority; preserve forensic evidence (original hash, current recomputed hash, difference analysis); escalate for manual investigation

step_1_collect_judgment_reports.action: Obtain Phase 17-2 overall judgment report and Phase 17-3 overall judgment report
step_1_collect_judgment_reports.prerequisite: Both judgment reports must be finalized

step_2_canonicalize_json.action: Canonicalize each judgment report JSON (sort keys, remove whitespace, ensure consistent formatting)
step_2_canonicalize_json.purpose: Ensure hash computation is deterministic regardless of JSON formatting variations

step_3_concatenate_reports.action: Concatenate canonicalized Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 JSON: combined_data = phase_17_2_json || phase_17_3_json
step_3_concatenate_reports.separator: Use explicit separator (e.g., '|||') to prevent collision attacks

step_4_compute_hash.action: Compute h = hash(combined_data) using SHA-256 or stronger

step_5_record_hash_metadata.action: Create hash record with: hash_value, algorithm, timestamp, input_size, canonicalization_method
step_5_record_hash_metadata.storage: Store in judgment result lock record

step_6_log_locking_event.action: Append audit log entry: JUDGMENT_LOCKED event with timestamp and hash value
step_6_log_locking_event.immutability: Log entry must be append-only; cannot modify prior entries

step_7_transition_state.action: Set lock_state to HASHED; lock is now ready for verification at Phase 15-7/15-8 entry

step_1_retrieve_judgment_reports.action: Obtain stored Phase 17-2 and Phase 17-3 judgment reports from secure storage

step_2_retrieve_stored_hash.action: Retrieve stored hash value h1 and metadata (algorithm, timestamp, canonicalization method)

step_3_recompute_hash.action: Canonicalize current judgment reports and recompute hash h2 using same algorithm and canonicalization method as original
step_3_recompute_hash.critical: Must use identical algorithm and canonicalization; any difference invalidates comparison

step_4_compare_hashes.if_equal: Hashes match; no tampering detected; proceed to step 5
step_4_compare_hashes.if_not_equal: Hashes mismatch; tampering detected; proceed to error handling (Procedure 3)

step_5_verify_timestamp_recency.action: Check lock timestamp is recent (e.g., within last 24 hours) and before Phase 15-7 entry time
step_5_verify_timestamp_recency.if_old: Flag as warning: lock is old; consider re-locking before Phase 15-7 entry

step_6_log_verification_success.action: Append audit log entry: HASH_VERIFIED_OK with verification timestamp

step_7_permit_phase15_7_entry.action: Judgment reports confirmed unmodified; Phase 15-7 measurement workflow can proceed
step_7_permit_phase15_7_entry.handoff: Pass locked judgment results to Phase 15-7 with lock_state=LOCKED

step_1_identify_tampering.action: Hash mismatch detected in Procedure 2 Step 4

step_2_preserve_forensic_evidence.action: Preserve for investigation: original hash h1, recomputed hash h2, current judgment reports, audit trail, system logs
step_2_preserve_forensic_evidence.immutability: Copy evidence to immutable storage; do not overwrite original records

step_3_compute_difference_analysis.action: Analyze what changed between original and current judgment reports (which fields, gate outcomes, decisions)

step_4_alert_security_authority.action: Issue security alert to authority: 'Tampering detected in Phase 17-2/17-3 judgment results; immediate investigation required'

step_5_log_tampering_event.action: Append audit log entry: TAMPERING_DETECTED with forensic evidence references

step_6_halt_processing.action: STOP: Do not proceed to Phase 15-7/15-8 measurement execution until tampering investigation resolved
step_6_halt_processing.halt_reason: Judgment result integrity compromised; measurement foundation unsound

step_7_escalate_for_investigation.action: Escalate to security/authority team; await decision on how to proceed (request rejudgment, investigate tampering source, etc.)

elements.judgment_report_id: Identifier of Phase 17-2 overall judgment report
elements.judgment_overall_result: Value of phase_17_2_measurement_workflow_feasibility_result (PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT) at time of locking

judgment_gate_outcomes.gate_1_through_6_locked_results: Copy of all 6 gate evaluation results at lock time (immutable reference)

elements.judgment_report_id: Identifier of Phase 17-3 overall judgment report
elements.judgment_overall_result: Value of phase_15_8_measurement_workflow_feasibility_result (PROCEED, HOLD, or HALT) at time of locking

judgment_gate_outcomes.gate_1_through_6_locked_results: Copy of all 6 gate evaluation results at lock time (immutable reference)

elements.combined_hash_timestamp: ISO8601 UTC when combined hash computed
elements.combined_input_size_bytes: Total size of concatenated canonicalized JSON

elements.event_type: JUDGMENT_LOCKED | HASH_VERIFIED_OK | HASH_VERIFIED_FAILED | TAMPER_DETECTED | VERIFICATION_ATTEMPTED | HALT_INITIATED

audit_trail.immutability_enforcement: Audit trail is append-only; existing entries cannot be deleted or modified

judgment_result_integrity_verification_a.requirement: Before Phase 15-7 or Phase 15-8 measurement workflow can execute, judgment result lock must be verified and lock_state must be LOCKED
judgment_result_integrity_verification_a.verification_logic: Invoke Procedure 2 (verification procedure); if LOCKED, proceed; if TAMPERING_DETECTED, halt immediately

depends_on: Phase 17-2: Phase 15-7 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment report (provides judgment results to lock)
Phase 17-3: Phase 15-8 measurement workflow execution feasibility judgment report (provides judgment results to lock)
feeds_into: Phase 17-5: PROCEED/HOLD/HALT handling rules (uses locked judgment results)
Phase 15-7 and Phase 15-8: Measurement workflows (verify judgment lock before entry)

design_review_checklist: Evidence lock purpose (prevent tampering of judgment results) clearly stated
Digital timestamp mechanism (UTC + optional TSA) designed
Tamper detection logic (hash mismatch → alert + halt) specified
State transition model (UNLOCKED → HASHED → LOCKED or TAMPERING_DETECTED) complete
Locking procedure (canonicalize, hash, record, log) step-by-step defined
Verification procedure (recompute hash, compare, verify timestamp) step-by-step defined
Tampering handling procedure (preserve forensic evidence, alert authority, halt) complete
Lock record structure (hashes, timestamps, audit trail) clearly defined
All blocked actions remain in governance

completion_gate.gate_condition: Judgment result evidence lock rules design approved AND verification procedures finalized
completion_gate.approval_required: Human technical reviewer + Phase 17 design authority + Security authority
completion_gate.prerequisite_for: Phase 17-5 (PROCEED/HOLD/HALT handling rules) can begin once judgment result locking rules are approved
